items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: No, the trombone player used to play with other bands; he was not in the band. I was the only trombone player with the White Brothers Band.

ctx.x: couldn't think of his name. But was that Tyree Glenn you were talking about?
No, that was White, I think. He came in there and played for awhile. I think now, I don't know.
